text: The Board confirms that each of these nominees is qualified to serve under the provisions of the City of Toronto's Public Appointments Policy and the Relationship Framework for Community Centre Boards of Management. On behalf of the Board, I respectfully request that the City take the necessary steps to appoint these nominated candidates. These appointments are a result of the following public members' desire to end their term early: - Abas Barra, term ending June 30, 2027 and until a successor is appointed. - Courtney Fitton, term ending June 30, 2027 and until a successor is appointed. - Rob Mackinnon, term ending June 30, 2027 and until a successor is appointed.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Appointed the following individuals to the Eastview Neighbourhood Community Centre Board, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending June 30, 2027, and until successors are appointed: - Bilaal Bana - Rizwan Desai - Julia Porter 2. Re-appointed the following members to the Eastview Neighbourhood Community Centre Board, at pleasure of Council, for the term of office ending June 30, 2028, and until successors are appointed: - Farhan Chaudhary - Claire Lukka - Dalreen Fobler - Mubarak Baker - Lauren Lee
